title: Students & Learners
problem: Social media and entertainment sites constantly interrupt study time
solution: Block distracting sites during study hours (9 AM - 5 PM on weekdays). Use Exception Patterns to allow educational YouTube channels while blocking entertainment content. Set Time-Based Blocking for 5 minutes of social media every hour as a reward.

title: Remote Workers
scenario: Maintaining productivity while working from home
problem: Home environment has more distractions than office
solution: Use Schedule Blocking for work hours (9 AM - 6 PM). Enable Active Tab Only mode to keep reference materials accessible in background tabs. Use Keyword Blocking to prevent accessing social media distractions.

title: Developers & Designers
scenario: Deep work sessions for complex projects
problem: Context switching destroys flow state and productivity
solution: Block all distractions during deep work blocks (2-4 hour sessions). Use Keyword Blocking to automatically block URLs with 'game', 'shopping', 'streaming'. Quick Pause for legitimate breaks without losing settings.

title: Parents & Families
scenario: Creating healthy digital habits for the whole family
problem: Kids (and adults) spend too much time on entertainment sites
solution: Set up family-wide blocking rules. Block gaming and streaming sites during homework time. Use Time-Based Blocking to allow 30 minutes of entertainment after completing tasks. Export/import settings across family devices.

title: Content Creators & Writers
problem: Research turns into endless browsing and procrastination
solution: Use Exception Patterns to allow research sites while blocking entertainment. Redirect social media to writing tools (e.g., twitter.com → notion.so). Track statistics to see time saved and stay motivated.

title: Anyone Building Better Habits
scenario: Breaking addiction to social media and news
problem: Compulsive checking of social media and news sites
solution: Start with Time-Based Blocking (5 min every 2 hours) to gradually reduce usage. Use Close Tab action for instant blocking. Track progress with statistics to see improvement over time. Celebrate streaks!
